claim: HazardPulse forecasts are frozen and Ed25519-signed BEFORE outcomes occur, committed to a public ledger, and independently verifiable by a self-contained verifier that runs no HazardPulse code.

evidence.note: Scoring pipeline, gate engine, and the committed forecast data under dist/.
Prediction ledger, gate decisions, provenance envelopes, and replay artifacts, committed on schedule with git timestamps.
Python stdlib + `cryptography` only; re-implements the published receipt spec rather than importing producer code.

how_to_verify: git clone https://github.com/coherence-energy-labs/hazardpulse && cd hazardpulse && python scripts/verify_forecast.py --artifact "$(ls dist/data/replay/eq_fcst_*.json | tail -n 1)"

limitations: Integrity verification requires no key; authenticity verification requires the published signing public key.
